title: L Prize Competition Winner: 60W Incandescent Replacement Lamp Update
lineage: The May 23, 2012 update dates the Philips L Prize announcement to August 3, 2011 and gives the winning lamp performance as 940 lumens and 94 lm/W. It does not establish purchase or sales on the award date.
